title: REPEAT Key Manifest Bundle
description: Signed bundle that binds an unsigned key manifest to a root trust anchor via a detached Ed25519 signature.

manifest_sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the canonical UTF-8 bytes of the manifest object.

root_key_id.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the raw bytes of the root public key used to sign this bundle.

signature_algorithm.description: Algorithm used to produce the detached signature.

signature_b64.description: Base64-encoded detached Ed25519 signature over the canonical UTF-8 bytes of the manifest object.
